decisions_ratified.decision: 5-layer architecture: L1 Source / L2 Orchestration (Turborepo) / L3 Packaging (Docker BuildKit) / L4 Pipeline (GitLab CI to Kubernetes) / L5 Verification
6 decoupling criteria: Substitutability, Hermeticity, Reproducibility, Failure Containment, Concern Atomicity, Lifecycle Independence
decisions_ratified.rationale: Empirically extracted from 8+ MAANG sources per 999.18.3-LAYER-ARCHITECTURE.md §D

decisions_ratified.decision: L1 host-dev: drop husky, drop prepare script, drop .husky/. Use .githooks/ + explicit pnpm setup-hooks (matches React/Astro public repos pattern)
decisions_ratified.rationale: Empirical evidence (verified 2026-05-04 via raw github.com WebFetches): React (Meta) has NO husky, NO prepare, NO .husky/. Astro has NO husky, NO prepare, NO .husky/. They rely entirely on CI for security enforcement. This is the most MAANG-aligned pattern (React + Astro public repos = ground truth). pnpm bug #7068 (prepare runs on --prod install) and husky lifecycle re-run on prune become irrelevant — there is no prepare script to leak into Docker.

decisions_ratified.decision: L3 substrate: two-install pattern (Vercel turborepo canonical). Stage 1.2 prod-deps = pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile. Stage 1.3 builder = pnpm install --frozen-lockfile + turbo build. NO pnpm prune --prod, NO --legacy flag, NO ENV CI=true, NO ENV HUSKY=0
decisions_ratified.rationale: Without prepare script in root package.json (per L1 decision above), two-install pattern works clean. pnpm bug #7068 becomes irrelevant. Two-install is canonical Vercel turborepo pattern. +30-60s build time accepted as cost of architectural cleanliness (zero flags, zero env-var workarounds).

decisions_ratified.decision: L4 platform: GitLab CI (per project_gitlab_migration memory + user confirmation 2026-05-04). Deploy target: Kubernetes (per project_hosting_infra memory). Enforcement layer: GitLab required pipelines + branch protection. security:* scripts from Phase 999.17 already integrated.
decisions_ratified.rationale: Server-side CI enforcement is canonical MAANG-aligned security layer. Local hooks = convenience only. 'Dev forgot setup' does NOT compromise security because GitLab CI runs same checks (gitleaks, semgrep, audit, trivy, env-parity, lint, typecheck) on every MR.

decisions_ratified.rationale: Layer architecture composes orthogonally with substrate decision. Most ADR locks survive; only sub-pattern within L3 packaging changed.

future_phase_seed.description: pnpm setup-hooks generates marker file (e.g. .git/hooks-installed). Dev runtime scripts (pnpm dev, pnpm start, etc) check marker on startup. If marker missing → fail fast with actionable message: 'Run pnpm setup-hooks first to install git hooks'. Catches 'dev forgot setup' at runtime entry point, not just at server-side. Separate phase from 999.18.3 — ergonomics enhancement, not core architecture.
